description: Open postings of one company on SmartRecruiters' public Posting API (pass the company identifier, e.g. canva). Title, city, region, country, location text, remote/hybrid flags, employment type, function, release time, and the posting's API link. Descriptions are not included. One company per call. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
